name: jev-box
description: Picks the Claude model for each turn and for selected subagents by asking TypeSafe Jev, directly or through OpenRouter; ships analyst-reviewer, system-analyst, feature-planner and review-plan skills with cheap Jev hints on requirements and plan steps.
